## Astronomical 0.2.57
This release introduces the one-shot command-line surface backed by the running Astronomical daemon.
### New CLI verbs
- `astronomical respond` — send a chat prompt to the running daemon and print the completion. - `astronomical embed` — request embeddings for text and print the embedding output. - `astronomical schema object` — generate JSON Schema descriptions for request and response objects. - `astronomical validate config` — validate an Astronomical runtime configuration file.
The verbs connect to the daemon over its IPC socket, report the ready model, and fail with clear errors when the daemon is not running or the requested model is not ready.
### Serving improvements
- Speculative prefill now fails open when a persisted target state vanishes, instead of blocking generation. - Added a representative-generation acceptance journey for speculative prefill streaming.
### Dependency hygiene
- Removed the unused WebP decoding feature from the image crate, shrinking the dependency surface.
### Compatibility
- The one-shot verbs require the Astronomical daemon to be running. - No changes to model packaging, memory policies, or on-disk instance state.
